note: MakeHuman's bundled assets (base mesh, skeleton, targets), CC0 since 2020, converted into HUMAN PACKS for tosijs-3d's character creator (CHARACTER-DESIGN.md) by bin/makehuman-pack.ts from a pinned commit of github.com/makehumancommunity/makehuman. Their code is AGPL and none of it is used. The originals land in source/, which no publish glob names. A pack is a manifest (hm08/hm08.json) plus binaries named by their content hash, so those can be cached forever; the manifest is the one file that changes.
